name: Maeno Ataru
source:
A fourth-year student majoring in physical education.

He entered the school, which is famous for its difficult entrance exams, through a sports recommendation, but he gained weight and couldn't get any credits. Graduation is also in a jeopardy.

He likes exercising, but can't do it as much as he wants and tends to give up on it.

[Translated from [url=https://karakuren.wixsite.com/kimikawa/maeno]official website[/url]]
